who was one of the seven,

when he had come to us,

The man whose belt this is,

both we and those who were from that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

And since we were not able to persuade him,

having made preparations, we ascended to Jerusalem.
Now some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us,
et ex discipulis a Cæsarea nobiscum,

adducentes secum apud quem hospitaremur Mnasonem quemdam Cyprium,
And when we had arrived at Jerusalem,
Sequenti autem die introibat Paulus nobiscum ad Jacobum,
Then, on the following day, Paul entered with us to James.
And all the elders were assembled.
And when he had greeted them,
narrabat per singula quæ Deus fecisset in gentibus per ministerium ipsius.
he explained each thing that God had accomplished among the Gentiles through his ministry.
magnified God and said to him:
quot millia sunt in Judæis qui crediderunt,
how many thousands there are among the Jews who have believed,
and they are all zealous for the law.
Audierunt autem de te quia discessionem doceas a Moyse eorum qui per gentes sunt Judæorum,
Now they have heard about you, that you are teaching those Jews who are among the Gentiles to withdraw from Moses,
dicens non debere eos circumcidere filios suos,
telling them that they should not circumcise their sons,
The multitude ought to be convened.
For they will hear that you have arrived.
Hoc ergo fac quod tibi dicimus.
Therefore, do this thing that we ask of you:
His assumptis, sanctifica te cum illis,
Take these and sanctify yourself with them,
et impende in illis ut radant capita:
and require them to shave their heads.
et scient omnes quia quæ de te audierunt, falsa sunt,
And then everyone will know that the things that they have heard about you are false,
sed ambulas et ipse custodiens legem.
but that you yourself walk in keeping with the law.
De his autem qui crediderunt ex gentibus,
But, about those Gentiles who have believed,
nos scripsimus judicantes ut abstineant se ab idolis immolato,
we have written a judgment that they should keep themselves from what has been immolated to idols, and from blood,
and from what has been suffocated,
Then Paul, taking the men on the next day,
postera die purificatus cum illis intravit in templum,
was purified with them, and he entered the temple,
announcing the process of the days of purification,
donec offerretur pro unoquoque eorum oblatio.
until an oblation would be offered on behalf of each one of them.
But when the seven days were reaching completion,
hi qui de Asia erant Judæi,
those Jews who were from Asia,
when they had seen him in the temple,
and they laid hands on him,
hic est homo qui adversus populum,
This is the man who is teaching,
against the people and the law and this place.
he has even brought Gentiles into the temple,
and he has violated this holy place.”
Viderant enim Trophimum Ephesium in civitate cum ipso,
(For they had seen Trophimus, an Ephesian, in the city with him,
quem æstimaverunt quoniam in templum introduxisset Paulus.
and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.)
And the entire city was stirred up.
And it happened that the people ran together.
they dragged him outside of the temple.
And immediately the doors were closed.
Then, as they were seeking to kill him,
nuntiatum est tribuno cohortis quia tota confunditur Jerusalem.
it was reported to the tribune of the cohort: “All Jerusalem is in confusion.”
Qui cum vidissent tribunum et milites,
And when they had seen the tribune and the soldiers,
et jussit eum alligari catenis duabus:
apprehended him and ordered that he be bound with two chains.
And he was asking who he was and what he had done.
Alii autem aliud clamabant in turba.
Then they were crying out various things within the crowd.
Et cum non posset certum cognoscere præ tumultu,
And since he could not understand anything clearly because of the noise,
he ordered him to be brought into the fortress.
And when he had arrived at the stairs,
contigit ut portaretur a militibus propter vim populi.
it happened that he was carried up by the soldiers, because of the threat of violence from the people.

qui ante hos dies tumultum concitasti,

Ego homo sum quidem Judæus a Tarso Ciliciæ,
“I am a man, indeed a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia,

permit me to speak to the people.”
